purpose: Sanitized real local handwriting diagnostic counts; no private pixels or values
reference_policy: 17 locally visually readable line references; 1 ambiguous line excluded; case and whitespace normalization only; no character repair
scope: 18 manually selected line crops across six supplied forms, including diagnostic fragments beyond brief targets; not complete-field accuracy
recommendation: Optional review-only evidence. Base recognizes some more lines, but neither checkpoint establishes robust identifier/date extraction; do not auto-accept handwriting.
observed_failures: Box/table rules confused handwritten account and IFSC recognition
Digits omitted/substituted or converted to words
Dates lost separators or became unrelated text
Rule cleanup changed predictions and can damage touching strokes

evaluation_limitations: Small manually selected crop set, not the official answer key
Visual references can themselves be uncertain; null references excluded
Repeated names and places reduce diversity
Line-level metrics do not establish complete field/pipeline accuracy
IAM-trained English model has domain shift on Indian insurance forms
